name: contract-method-registration
goal: Class and API matrices register exact canonical cases with no computed, missing, duplicate or extra callbacks

evidence: New class lifecycle migrations use finite matrices, but ordinary computed test titles are intentionally rejected by static discovery. Method/API cases need canonical manifest-driven registration analogous to helper Examples, retaining each original fixture and assertion.

The TestExpectationService method suite currently covers three public methods. Declare registerCases as a new fourth capability and its initialized case, asserting lazy registration, exact file/title identity, missing/extra callbacks and full API JSON result checks. Bug fixes within that new case retain its count.
